title: SendGrid 400 'All values of custom arguments object must be strings' when passing an ID or flag
symptoms: 400 Bad Request: All values of custom arguments object must be strings
Fails as soon as a numeric user_id, a boolean, or an array goes into custom_args
An empty custom_args object is rejected too
cause: Mail Send v3 accepts only string values in custom_args, at the message level and in each personalization, and rejects an empty object.
fix: Convert every custom_args value to a string before sending, omit custom_args when there is nothing to send, and keep the merged size under 50,000 bytes per personalization.
apply:
const custom_args = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(args).map(([k, v]) => [k, typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v)]));
if (Object.keys(custom_args).length) msg.custom_args = custom_args;
affected: SendGrid v3 Mail Send, as of 2026-10
